src/context/ToastContext.jsx:export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'info', duration = 4000) => {
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:    const id = Date.now() + Math.random()
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:    setToasts(prev => [...prev, { id, message, type, duration }])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  }, [])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:    setToasts(prev => prev.filter(toast => toast.id !== id))
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  }, [])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const success = useCallback((message) => showToast(message, 'success'), [showToast])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const error = useCallback((message) => showToast(message, 'error'), [showToast])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const warning = useCallback((message) => showToast(message, 'warning'), [showToast])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  const info = useCallback((message) => showToast(message, 'info'), [showToast])
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  return (
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:    <ToastContext.Provider value={{ showToast, success, error, warning, info }}>
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:      {children}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:      
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:      {/* Toast Container */}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:      <div className="fixed top-4 right-4 z-[1000] flex flex-col gap-3 max-w-md pointer-events-none">
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:        {toasts.map((toast) => (
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:          <div key={toast.id} className="pointer-events-auto">
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:            <Toast
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:              message={toast.message}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:              type={toast.type}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:              duration={toast.duration}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:              onClose={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:            />
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:          </div>
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:        ))}
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:      </div>
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:    </ToastContext.Provider>
src/context/ToastContext.jsx:  )
